GATE_PUBLISH_PRODUCT.name: Product Publication Gate
GATE_PUBLISH_PRODUCT.description: Triggered whenever a product draft is nominated for transition from Draft to Published state.

GATE_PRICE_CHANGE_LARGE.name: Large Price Variance Gate (>5%)
GATE_PRICE_CHANGE_LARGE.description: Triggered whenever a suggested or calculated price differs from the baseline product price by more than 5%.

GATE_MEDIA_REPLACE.name: Product Media Replacement Gate
GATE_MEDIA_REPLACE.description: Triggered whenever a primary catalog image or gallery image set is replaced or re-ordered.

GATE_AI_IMAGE_REPLACE.name: AI Image Replacement Gate
GATE_AI_IMAGE_REPLACE.description: Triggered if any AI-cleaned or AI-processed image is proposed to replace an authentic real product photo.

GATE_DIRECT_MUTATION.name: Direct Host / Database Mutation Gate
GATE_DIRECT_MUTATION.description: Triggered for any action that mutates live production database or writes non-staged files.
